setup.title: Launch the CloudLab experiment (1 name server + 2 load generators)
commands: python3 cloudlab_api/launch.py launch --name dns-d710 --num-testers 2 --server-software bind --server-hw d710 --tester-hw d710
python3 cloudlab_api/launch.py status <experiment_id>   # node ssh commands

setup.title: On test_host_0: create an SSH key and authorize it on every node
commands: cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub   # append this line to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on NS_Local and test_host_1

setup.title: On test_host_0: generate the zone and load it on the name server
On every load generator: receive replies on one RX queue (kxdpgun in generic mode reads queue 0 only)
Point the search config at this machine
Use the second load generator too (test_host_1, 10.10.1.3)

optimize.title: Host changes (run as root on NS_Local)
commands:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/dnstune.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
cmp -s /users/ckranig/multi_record/db.workbench.lan /etc/bind/db.workbench.lan || cp /users/ckranig/multi_record/db.workbench.lan /etc/bind/db.workbench.lan
for g in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor; do echo performance > $g; done
for s in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpuidle/state3/disable /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpuidle/state4/disable; do echo 1 > $s; done
echo always > /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled
echo 5000000 > /sys/kernel/debug/sched/migration_cost_ns
ethtool -G eno4 rx 2040
sleep 3
ethtool -C eno4 rx-usecs 100 rx-frames 64 rx-usecs-irq 100 rx-frames-irq 64 tx-usecs 200 tx-frames 64 tx-usecs-irq 200 tx-frames-irq 64
ethtool -K eno4 gro off
sysctl -w net.core.default_qdisc=pfifo_fast
tc qdisc replace dev eno4 root mq
for q in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do printf '%x' $((1<<q)) > /sys/class/net/eno4/queues/tx-$q/xps_cpus; done
systemctl stop irqbalance
for q in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do irq=$(awk -v n=eno4-$q '$NF==n {sub(":","",$1); print $1}' /proc/interrupts); [ -n "$irq" ] && echo $q > /proc/irq/$irq/smp_affinity_list; done
systemctl --no-block stop collectl apache2 packagekit
exit 0
EOF

sed -i 's/^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT=.*/GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="mitigations=off cpufreq.default_governor=performance apparmor=0 init_on_alloc=0 hardened_usercopy=off cgroup.memory=nokmem audit=0 nowatchdog"/' /etc/default/grub
